conversations.title: Bridge round — terms walkthrough
conversations.summary:
Dana walked through the bridge terms. €2.4M on a €18M pre-money cap with a 20% discount, structured as a convertible. Existing investors are taking €1.1M; the remaining €1.3M is open.

The 94% return rate on the retail pilot held through August across all four supermarket chains. German expansion is gated on one certification that lands in Q1.

He asked directly whether Example Ventures would lead. I said we would need to see October cohort data before committing to a lead position, but that we could anchor.
action_items: Send the data room link before Friday
Introduce Dana to Avery at Northwind
Review October cohort data when it lands

conversations.title: Initech AI — first look
conversations.generated_summary:
A short introductory call about Initech AI. Jordan described the product as a compliance-monitoring layer for Nordic financial institutions, currently in pilot with two banks. He mentioned the team is four people, all technical, and that they have not raised institutionally yet.

The call ended early — Jordan had a hard stop. No numbers were discussed.
generated_action_items: Book a longer session to cover metrics and the raise

conversations.title: Co-invest — Globex Pack
conversations.summary:
Avery is warm on Globex Pack but Northwind's packaging thesis sits with a different partner. She will take it to Monday's meeting rather than push it herself.

Her read on the cap: fair for the traction, rich if the German certification slips past Q1. She has seen two comparable rounds price 15-20% lower in the last quarter.

We agreed to share diligence rather than duplicate it — she takes the technical certification path, we take the retail unit economics.
action_items: Send Avery our retail unit economics model
Wait for Northwind's Monday partner meeting

conversations.title: Hooli — technical deep dive
conversations.generated_summary:
Morgan took us through Hooli's battery management architecture. The core claim is a 12% improvement in usable cycle life through predictive cell balancing, validated on their own test rigs but not yet by a third party.

Most of the hour went to the question of whether the gain survives at pack scale. Morgan was candid that their pack-level data comes from a single customer deployment and that the effect there was closer to 7%.

They are pre-revenue, funded by a national innovation grant through mid-2027.
generated_action_items: Ask for the third-party validation timeline

conversations.title: Initech AI — intro, via Avery
conversations.summary:
Introductory call, warm intro from Avery. Initech is building compliance monitoring for Nordic banks — the pitch is that existing tooling is built for US regulation and fits Nordic requirements badly.

Two pilots running, both unpaid. Jordan was clear that converting one to paid is the milestone before they raise.

He is not raising yet. Worth staying close.
action_items: Check back after the pilot conversion

conversations.title: Globex Pack — August board observer call
conversations.summary:
Monthly update. Revenue €218k for July, up from €186k in June. Burn steady at €95k.

The Hamburg pilot went live on the 22nd with two chains rather than the three that were planned — the third pushed to September over shelf-space negotiations, not product.

Dana flagged that their operations lead is leaving in October. He is not replacing the role directly; he wants to split it between two existing people and see if it holds.
action_items: Ask about the operations handover plan in September
Track whether the third Hamburg chain lands

conversations.title: Globex Pack — retail unit economics
conversations.summary:
Deep dive on the container economics. Cost per unit is €4.10 at current volume, falling to a modelled €2.85 at 500k units.

The return rate is the whole business: at 94% the unit pays back after 11 cycles. At 85% it never does. Every question worth asking about this company is a question about return rate.

Dana's answer on why theirs holds: deposit value set deliberately high, and the collection points are inside the store rather than outside it.
action_items: Model the downside case at 85% return

conversations.title: Globex Pack — first meeting
conversations.summary:
First conversation, inbound via the website. Reusable packaging for grocery retail, founded 2024, based in Rotterdam.

Two founders, both ex-Kwik-E-Mart. Dana ran operations there; his co-founder is technical.

Too early for us at the time — pre-revenue, one letter of intent. Agreed to revisit once the first chain went live.

conversations.title: Northwind — quarterly catch-up
conversations.summary:
General catch-up with Avery. Northwind has slowed materially on climate hardware — two write-downs last year made the partnership cautious on anything capital-intensive.

She is personally still interested and is looking for co-invest rather than lead positions in the space.

Worth keeping her on the list for anything hardware-adjacent where we can lead.
